## Natural history notes

A large darner dragonfly characterized by its long slender body, clear wings, green thorax, and dark abdomen marked with pale green to bluish spots. In Florida, it is found around ponds, lakes, marshes, swamps, canals, ditches, and other warm freshwater wetlands with emergent vegetation and open flight space. Adults are strong aerial predators that catch mosquitoes, flies, moths, and other flying insects, often patrolling over wetland edges, while the aquatic nymphs live among submerged vegetation and prey on small aquatic animals.
